candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs confirm whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or pool exhaustion.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout; metrics show 16 502s and p95 ~2425ms on checkout. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs showing connection pool or Redis client errors
Excluded logs evidence ev-da103b2d31096bf0-r0-logs not admitted
